description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using Consul as the backend. It verifies core functionalities such as reading, writing, updating, and cleaning up membership entries, as well as gateway discovery, specifically testing the Consul-based membership provider within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: ConsulMembershipTableTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of Orleans membership table using Consul, including operations like insert, update, read, heartbeat, cleanup, and gateway discovery.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates logger filter options for tracing Consul-based membership table activities.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of ConsulBasedMembershipTable configured with the provided logger.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of ConsulGatewayListProvider for gateway discovery.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Retrieves the Consul connection string asynchronously.

methods.name: MembershipTable_GetGateways
methods.description: Test method for verifying gateway retrieval via Consul.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method for reading from an empty membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_InsertRow
methods.description: Test method for inserting a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for reading a membership row after insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for reading all membership entries after insertions.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method for updating a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method for concurrent updates to a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method for heartbeat updates to indicate liveness.

methods.name: MembershipTable_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test for removing dead or defunct silo entries.
